description: Random voltage generator with an internal clock and four ways of travelling between values

params.text: Sets the rate of the internal clock, from 0.002Hz to 2000Hz; its light blinks on each tick
Sets how the outputs travel from the old value to the new one, from an instant jump at 0% to taking the whole clock cycle at 100%
Switches the outputs between -5V to 5V and 0-10V
Sets the chance that a tick produces a new value; its light blinks whenever one is produced
Sets how far a new value may move from the one before it: at 100% the new value is drawn freely, and at 0% it repeats the previous value
Scales the RATE input from -100% to 100%; at 100% each volt doubles the clock rate
Scales the SHAPE input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the PROB input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the RND input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Moves the clock rate by an amount set by the RATE attenuverter
Moves the shape by an amount set by the SHAPE attenuverter
A trigger here replaces the internal clock, and the RATE slider is ignored; the PROB slider thins the incoming triggers
A voltage here is sampled on each trigger in place of a random value, and the RND slider has no effect
Moves the probability by an amount set by the PROB attenuverter
Moves the spread by an amount set by the RND attenuverter

outputs.text: Travels to the new value in equally spaced steps: one step at 0% shape, sixteen across the clock cycle at 100%
Travels to the new value along a straight line, arriving early and holding at low shape settings and taking the whole cycle at 100%
Travels to the new value along a sine curve, then holds until the cycle finishes
Travels to the new value exponentially, the time constant set by the shape, becoming a straight line at 100%
A pulse each time a new value is generated

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
